Execution order: Markdown step 2 of 12. Depends on Adashi task ID 25 (Markdown 01/12 — Extend the shared design document and storage API contract). Complete and verify that prerequisite before starting; all earlier Markdown steps are transitively required.

Implement the shared Markdown contract in src-tauri/src/storage/sqlite and its schema, snapshot, mutations, design/documents, references and transfer inventories.
Scope:
- Add a supported transactional schema upgrade for documents and ordered typed associations. Preserve existing identities, task/QA evidence, drafts, receipts and unrelated data. Old projects must not receive invented design documents.
- Implement create/read/update/delete, metadata inventory, scoped lookup, bindings, title/body search and canonical snapshots/readTokens. Include markdown in the resource and reference graph.
- Compare tokens and validate the final reference graph in the same write transaction as body/title/link changes, resource versions, receipt and one committed change notification.
- Support guarded detachment for deletion; reject dangling task/QA/document links and preserve documents when architecture associations are removed.
- Preserve semantic no-ops and same-operation replay. Initialized read-only queries must not change project bytes, mtime or revision.
Acceptance:
- SQLite upgrade and regression tests preserve representative existing projects.
- Test multiline Unicode/code fences, long complete bodies, project isolation, duplicate identities, exact association ordering, stale updates/deletes, disjoint writes, invalid references, rollback, idempotent replay and changed-argument receipt rejection.
- Query and guarded write behavior satisfies the shared contract without direct database access in desktop or MCP.

Formal design: retrieve the linked owner specifications. The Markdown extension saved on 2026-09-25 is approved design; implementation remains pending until this task is verified.

data.title: Markdown 02/12 — Implement SQLite persistence and guarded document mutations
